meta.title: Folo RSS reader
meta.description: Subscribe to RSS and Atom feeds, read them in a two-pane reader, and keep unread and starred state in the sidebar.

splitter.label: Resize the entry list
splitter.hint: Drag, or use the arrow keys, to change the list width.

list.emptyHint: Entries show up after a feed is fetched.
list.noFeedsHint: Add an RSS or Atom feed, or import an OPML file from another reader.

reader.emptyHint: Pick something from the list to read it here.
reader.noContent: This entry has no content. Open the original to read it.

dialog.addHint: Paste an RSS or Atom URL. A website address also works when the site advertises a feed.
dialog.importHint: Pick an OPML file exported from another reader.

toast.alreadySubscribed: That feed is already in your library
toast.importEmpty: No feeds found in that file

settings.title: Reading settings
settings.languageHint: Changes this reader's own labels; the rest of DeepSeek keeps its language.

error.invalid_url: That is not a valid URL.
error.unsupported_protocol: Only http and https feeds are supported.
error.no_feed: No RSS or Atom feed was found at that address.
error.http_status: The feed server returned an error.
error.too_large: That feed is too large to load.
error.empty_feed: That feed document has no entries.
error.entry_not_found: That entry is no longer available.
error.invalid_setting: That setting value is not accepted.
error.unreachable: Could not reach that feed. Try again later.
